basics.name: Ada Meridian
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 6 years building backend APIs and data pipelines in Python and PostgreSQL. Reduced p95 latency 40% on a payments API and led a 4-person squad.

work.name: Northwind Labs
highlights: Built FastAPI services on PostgreSQL that processed 2M payments per month with 99.95% uptime.
Cut p95 API latency 40% by adding Redis caching and query indexes.
Led a 4-person squad to migrate monolith jobs onto Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
Wrote pytest coverage from 41% to 82% and introduced on-call runbooks.

work.name: Helios Analytics
highlights: Shipped Python ETL jobs that loaded 50GB/day into PostgreSQL for analyst dashboards.
Implemented REST endpoints in Django for internal reporting used by 30 analysts.
Automated weekly Excel exports, saving 8 hours of manual work each week.

projects.name: Invoice Parser
highlights: Parsed 10k invoices with pdfminer and FastAPI, 97% field accuracy.
